caption: The drawing depicts a wooden dresser with a total of nine drawers. The dresser is shown from the front and is composed of two primary colors: a rich, dark brown for the majority of the body and drawer fronts, and a lighter, golden-brown wood for the central column of smaller drawers. The dresser features subtle curved legs and a scalloped lower edge. Each drawer is outlined with a thin light-colored inlay at the edges and the four corners of each drawer front have a triangular decorative inlay in a matching light color. The three small central drawers vertically aligned in the middle of the dresser are each equipped with a small keyhole, and the topmost central drawer includes an oval brass escutcheon plate with an engraved design. The six larger side drawers (three on each side) have brass oval drawer pulls fixed horizontally in the center of each drawer. The body of the dresser is bordered by a fine, darker trim, and the wood grain pattern is visible throughout the entire dresser, emphasizing the material's natural texture. The background is plain and off-white. There are two short handwritten inscriptions, one in the lower-left corner, another lower right, in cursive script.
title: Chest of Drawers
